note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Genesis names Gomorrah alongside Sodom, Admah and Zeboiim when describing the boundary of Canaanite territory. The kings of Sodom and Gomorrah flee in the Valley of Siddim.

evidence.note: The boundary description lists עֲמֹרָה between Sodom and Admah.
The king of Gomorrah flees along with the king of Sodom in the Valley of Siddim.
Sodom and Gomorrah are named together as the cities whose property was taken.
